title: Upload Row
description: One row = one (tile, metric_definition, metric_value) tuple. Field names follow the `entity.attribute` convention from App\Services\Export\FieldWhitelist so the row shape is symmetric with the JSON export.

tile.id.description: Ignored on import; tenant-local IDs are regenerated.

tile.slug.description: URL-safe de-slug; natural key of the tile within the tenant.

tile.title.description: Required on create. de locale required, en optional.

tile.time_granularity.description: Granularity of the tile's periods. Set when the tile is created (default `year`); must match an existing tile's granularity. Every value.granularity of the tile must equal it.

category.labels.description: Ignored on import; informational only (comes from export).

category.groups.description: Ignored on import; informational only (comes from export).

metric.key.description: Required if value.value is set. Unique per tile; groups rows into one metric definition.

metric.source.description: Reserved for a later schema version. Accepted but currently not persisted.

metric.source_url.description: Reserved. Accepted but currently not persisted.

metric.methodology.description: Reserved. Accepted but currently not persisted.

metric.formula.description: Reserved. Accepted but currently not persisted.

value.year.description: Calendar year (v1 period). Maps to a year-granularity TimePeriod (period_key = the 4-digit year). Used only when value.period_key is absent; the export always writes it as the leading year of the period.

value.period_key.description: Period of the value in ISO form, as written by the export: `2023`, `2023-Q1`, `2023-05`, `2023-W05` or `2023-05-15`. Takes precedence over value.year; if both are set, value.year must be its leading year. Must match value.granularity.

value.granularity.description: Granularity of value.period_key. Defaults to `year`. Requires value.period_key, and must equal the tile's time_granularity.

allOf.description: If value.value is provided, metric.key and a period (value.period_key or value.year) are required.

translatable_string.description: A {de, en} object, or a plain string as written by the export, stored as the translation for bundle.locale (default `de`).

oneOf.description: HTML as written by the JSON export, stored as given (like the admin editor and API) as the translation for bundle.locale (default `de`).
